task.title: Reuse the day's player file between deploys and fall back to it when a download fails
task.description:
## Why
PR #5 built most of this story: `web/scripts/build_data.py` writes the trimmed player file (12 fields, about 390 KB compressed) and the snapshot index, the deploy workflow runs it on every deploy, and staging redeploys daily. A failed or short download (under 5,000 players) fails the run before anything is deployed, so the live site keeps its previous files.

What is left: every deploy downloads Sleeper's full player table again, and Sleeper asks clients to fetch it at most once a day. A code deploy also cannot ship while Sleeper is down.

## Steps
1. Save the day's player file and snapshot index in an Actions cache, keyed by date.
2. Reuse the same day's files on later deploys instead of downloading again.
3. When a download fails or returns far fewer players than the cached file, deploy with the most recent cached files and mark the run with a warning.
4. Once the fixture set exists, confirm the 12 player fields against every fixture.

## Done when
- Two deploys on the same day download the player table once.
- A deploy while Sleeper is down ships with the last good files and says so in the run.

comments.author: dylan@dgoings.com
comments.body: Trimmed to what is left after PR #5 (script, daily staging schedule and the 5,000-player floor are done).
